terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.subtitle: The rules that keep Edeviser safe, reliable, and fair for every learner and institution.
terms.summary: Use the platform responsibly, protect your account, and respect other people’s access and content.

1.title: 1. Acceptance of terms
1.body: By accessing or using the Edeviser platform, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, you may not use the platform.

2.title: 2. Description of service
2.body: Edeviser is an outcome-based education management platform that provides tools for learning management, assessment, gamification, and accreditation support.

3.title: 3. User accounts
3.body: You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials. You must notify us immediately of any unauthorized use of your account.

4.title: 4. Acceptable use
4.body: You agree not to misuse the platform, including attempting to gain unauthorized access, interfering with other users, or uploading malicious content.

5.title: 5. Intellectual property
5.body: Content you create on the platform remains yours. Edeviser retains rights to the platform software, design, and branding.

6.title: 6. Limitation of liability
6.body: Edeviser is provided as is without warranties of any kind. We are not liable for indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of the platform.

7.title: 7. Changes to terms
7.body: We may update these terms from time to time. Continued use of the platform after changes constitutes acceptance of the updated terms.

8.title: 8. Contact
8.body: For questions about these terms, contact our legal team.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: How Edeviser collects, protects, and uses information across the learning journey.
privacy.summary: We use data to deliver learning services and institution analytics. We do not sell personal data.

1.title: 1. Information we collect
1.body: We collect information you provide directly, including your name, email, and institution, plus usage data such as page views and feature interactions.

2.title: 2. How we use your information
2.body: Your data is used to provide and improve Edeviser, personalize learning, generate analytics for educators, and support accreditation processes.

3.title: 3. Cookies
3.body: We use essential cookies for authentication and session management. Analytics cookies are enabled only with your explicit consent.

4.title: 4. Data sharing
4.body: We do not sell personal data. Data may be shared with your institution’s administrators and educators when required for educational purposes.

5.title: 5. Data retention
5.body: Data is retained for the duration of your account. After account deletion, personal data is removed within 30 days. Anonymized analytics may be retained.

6.title: 6. Your rights
6.body: You may access, correct, or delete your personal data. You can export your data from profile settings.

7.title: 7. Security
7.body: We use industry-standard safeguards, including encryption in transit, row-level security, and regular security reviews.

8.title: 8. Contact
8.body: For privacy-related questions, contact our privacy team.
